olga_cs: Triton Logistics (contact: jay@tritonlog) requested onboarding for a custom manifest anonymizer + entity-extraction model. They want Private deployment (VPC), HSM for keys, and a strict "no persistent token storage" policy. Also asking for p95 <= 320ms for single-row lookups and an eval plan. Can someone pick this up?
matt_se: I'll own SE work. Do we know framework/size and whether theyexpect realtime or batched inference?
olga_cs: Jay: PyTorch 2.1, ~5.2B, optimized for per-row inference (real-time). They can share artifacts and 1k sample rows but need an NDA addendum limiting debug logs.
yara_safety: Safety questions: list of fields considered sensitive? Any regulatory constraints (e.g., customs IDs flagged as sensitive in APAC)? We'll need adversarial probes focused on PHI/PII-style masking and a tolerance threshold for missed redactions.
olga_cs: Jay replied: "No PHI, sensitive fields = customer_id, container_serial, contact_phone, customs_ref. APAC rules apply for some customs refs." They prefer masking over deletion for downstream parsing.
samir_pm: Product notes: ephemeral KV cache only, no token persistence, HSM-backed audit log OK. For p95 320ms we'll likely recommend a small Dedicated pool in-region; that has renewal/commercial implications. Tagging @luke_sales for pricing.
infra_bot: ticket created CS-9123 "triton manifest anonymizer onboard" https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/CS-9123 :white_check_mark:
matt_se: Ops ask: request ~500 representative rows + schema + target QPS/concurrency. I'll run a perf sweep with quantization and warm KV cache disabled to measure tail. Example perf command:
```
./run_eval --model triton_artifact.pt --data sample_manifests.jsonl --qps 20 --concurrency 6 --quantize int8 --ephemeral-kv --out triton_results.json
```
yara_safety: Eval plan (short): 1) redaction adversarial set (600 examples), 2) extraction recall/precision on canonical fields, 3) prompt-injection stress tests, 4) latency p95/p99 at 10/20/50 QPS. Deliver redaction FNR/FPR and list of high-severity misses. Need samples by Thu to hit SLAs.
luke_sales: I'll prep a pricing sketch for Dedicated + HSM surcharge and join the QBR. Note: reserved capacity required for predictable latency => commercial term to discuss.
olga_cs: Scheduling enablement + infra sync with Jay Wed 9am PT. I'll request dataset + NDA addendum now. Matt: ETA 48-72h after we get samples for perf + safety results.
matt_se: Copy that. Will post CS-9123 updates when runs complete. :hourglass:
